selected.summary: Everyday AI discusses how repeated agent actions, tool use and model choices can affect AI spending. Its published topic list and chapters cover automation-loop costs, model mixtures and approaches to monitoring and managing usage; this selection treats those as discussion topics, not verified savings or current vendor-pricing guidance.
selected.why_it_matters: Gives teams a spending-governance lens to use alongside technical model selection, agent adoption and role-based learning. Readers can use the episode to frame questions about task budgets and usage visibility before approving broader automation.
selected.editorial_limitation: Reviewed publisher description and chapters only, not audio. The show's claims about subscription changes, specific products and cost-saving effectiveness were not independently verified and are not repeated as facts.
